workspaces.description: Each key is a workspace name. The name is also the Rex session's label.

root.description: Folder that every cwd is relative to. ~ works. Default: your home folder.

key.description: Shortcut that opens this workspace, such as ctrl+cmd+1.

focus.description: Name of the tab to show when the session is created. Default: the first tab.

switch.description: Switch the app to the session after start.

servers_in.description: Put servers in floating panes, or side by side in a tab named servers.

stop_timeout.description: Seconds to wait after Ctrl-C, for servers and panes. Then close ones close anyway.

stop.description: What Stop does. Restart uses only servers. Close always ends the session.

servers.description: close: Ctrl-C, wait, close the pane. interrupt: Ctrl-C only, the pane stays. leave: nothing.

panes.description: For tab panes. leave: nothing. interrupt: Ctrl-C busy panes, they stay. close: Ctrl-C busy panes, wait, close all of them, but never the session's last pane.

servers.description: Long-running commands. Stop presses Ctrl-C in each.

tabs.description: Tabs to open. Default: one shell at root.

label.description: Pane label. Unique within the workspace.

cmd.description: Command typed into the pane's shell.

stop.description: What Stop does to this server. Default: the workspace's stop.servers.

worktree.description: Run in this git worktree of the folder's repository instead of the folder itself: a branch, a worktree folder name, or a path. The same subfolder is used in the worktree.

bounds.description: [x, y, width, height] of the floating pane, as fractions of the window. Default: stacked on the right.

split.description: Panes side by side, stacked, or in a grid: rows of equal width, filled left to right. 4 panes make a 2x2 grid.

size.description: Share of the width (split right) or height (split down) this pane takes, from 0 to 1. Panes without a size split what is left evenly. Ignored in a grid.

group.description: Panes that share one slot of the tab, split their own way. For example, a stack beside a main pane.

cmd.description: Command typed into the shell when the pane opens.

stop.description: What Stop does to this pane. Default: the workspace's stop.panes.

worktree.description: Run in this git worktree of the folder's repository instead of the folder itself: a branch, a worktree folder name, or a path. The same subfolder is used in the worktree.

hooks.description: Shell commands run in root. Each has 20 seconds; a failing before_start stops the start.
